content.comment_body: Hello, I am unable to connect with [product_name] and keep receiving the message that the value for the HMI button input cannot be written to the controller ([product_name]?). I believe the network settings are correct.

Hello, This forum is in English, so please post your questions in English to receive more assistance. Can you provide more information about the input you want to write? Directly writing to inputs is not possible; instead, use a bit in V-memory. This [url] might be helpful: How do you establish a connection between a [product_name] and an HMI panel?

To clarify: You cannot control the physical inputs of a [product_name] from the HMI. You can only set bits in the VM area (Vx.y), flags (Mx), or physical outputs (Qx). However, flags or outputs can be controlled only if their input side is not connected to other blocks. Please upload your [product_name] program and your engineering project as a ZIP file.

analysis.insight_summary: The user tried to connect an HMI panel with a [product_name] controller but ran into problems sending values from the HMI to the device. The main challenge was the expectation to write data to physical inputs, which is not allowed; only specific memory areas or outputs can be written to from the HMI. This limitation is built into the system and not apparent to newcomers.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to control physical inputs on the [product_name] directly from the HMI panel and is seeking guidance on how to set up the connection, ensuring button presses are registered by the controller.
